topic: 视丘的三张面孔：感觉门控、认知放大器与意识开关

sources.title: Thalamic bursting and the role of timing and synchrony in thalamocortical signaling in the awake mouse
sources.relevance: 清醒动物视丘爆发放电的功能；timing-based gating 模型
sources.key_findings: 爆发放电在清醒动物中占~15%反应；不增加皮层幅度但改变时序精度；提出timing-based gating

sources.title: Spike and burst coding in thalamocortical relay cells
sources.relevance: 计算模型分析爆发/强直放电的信息论特性差异
sources.key_findings: 爆发→低频5Hz，高度对新颖性敏感；强直→高频50Hz，线性传递；支持wake-up call假说

sources.title: The Mediodorsal Thalamus: An Essential Partner of Prefrontal Cortex for Cognition
sources.relevance: MD视丘对PFC工作记忆和认知灵活性的贡献
sources.key_findings: MD损害工作记忆晚期维持；MD-mPFC θ/β同步与学习；精神分裂症中MD-dlPFC连接降低∝认知缺陷

sources.title: Prefrontal Projections to the Thalamic Reticular Nucleus form a Unique Circuit for Attentional Mechanisms
sources.relevance: PFC→TRN 大型端钮驱动型突触；注意门控的解剖基础
sources.key_findings: PFC→TRN含大型端钮(~1.69μm)=驱动型；感觉皮层→TRN小型端钮(~0.82μm)=调制型；PFC可通过TRN覆盖感觉输入

sources.title: Thalamic functions in distributed cognitive control
sources.relevance: 视丘对分布式认知控制的功能综述
sources.key_findings: 视丘回路转换和维持皮层功能性连接；支持任务相关网络快速重组（摘要信息）

sources.title: Thalamocortical loops as temporal demodulators across senses
sources.relevance: 视丘-皮层回路作为相位锁定环路；时间编码→频率编码转换
sources.key_findings: 视丘-皮层环路跨感觉模态功能为时间去调制器（PLL）；将时序感觉信号转化为皮层频率码

sources.title: Gating and control of primary visual cortex by pulvinar
sources.relevance: 枕核对初级视觉皮层的主动门控作用
sources.key_findings: 枕核灭活→95%V1神经元反应消失；枕核是V1运转的主动维持者；提供空间注意门控

sources.title: Thalamus and consciousness: a systematic review on thalamic nuclei associated with consciousness
sources.relevance: 视丘核团与意识的系统综述
sources.key_findings: CM-Pf核最强与意识相关；MD排名第二；DBS靶向中央视丘可诱导植物人状态意识恢复

sources.title: Transthalamic Pathways for Cortical Function
sources.fulltext_source: PDF格式无法解析；仅文章信息可获
sources.relevance: 一次/高次视丘核和驱动/调制区分的2024年更新综述
sources.key_findings: 高次视丘核接受L5驱动输入；皮层A→高次视丘→皮层B路径并行于直接皮层连接（来自搜索摘要）

sources.title: On the actions that one nerve cell can have on another: distinguishing 'drivers' from 'modulators'
sources.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
sources.relevance: 驱动/调制二元框架的原始论文
sources.key_findings: 区分驱动型（传递感受野特性）和调制型（改变传递效率）突触输入
